name: Kamebuchi Keiko
source:
A woman of many misfortunes, her weak condition seemingly led to her being hospitalized for a long period of time.

While a participant in Divine Selection, Alan acquires her name card immediately after the ritual began.

[From [url=http://fatal12.com/en.html#kik]official site[/url]]
